notes.title: Orange Life is here
notes.content:
🟠 Orange Life is now live on Steam!
I'm excited to announce that Orange Life has officially launched on Steam!
🔗[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842430/Orange_Life/"][/dynamiclink]

💰 The game is available at a fair price, so anyone can jump in and enjoy the world of Orange Life.

🛠️ I’m already working on future updates that will include:

New features

Bug fixes

Quality improvements

🎮 Your feedback is more than welcome — it helps shape the game and make it better for everyone. Let’s build something great together!

Thanks for all the support!
Let the orange adventure begin! 🍊

notes.title: Orange Life - Release
notes.content:
🚨 Official Launch Announcement – Orange Life Releases July 22! 🚨
Hey everyone!
After years of work, Orange Life is finally ready to hit the streets – and the full version launches on July 22! 🔥

🧡 Orange Life is a chaotic, immersive open-world experience where everything is interactive – from traffic lights and elevators to your own apartment. Complete missions, drive cars, explore the madness, and live the orange dream.

🚗 Full game includes:

New missions and features

Improved performance & bug fixes

A whole lot of chaos and surprises

✅ Until launch day, you can still play the FREE DEMO right now on Steam and get a taste of the action!
👉 Play the demo here

📅 Mark your calendars – July 22, 2025. Orange Life goes full release.
Thank you all for the support! This indie journey means everything.

– One Dev, One Vision, One Orange Life
